rubric.role_summary: Senior platform engineering role developing and operating distributed block-storage systems for stateful workloads across cloud and bare-metal environments.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior platform engineering role developing and operating distributed block-storage systems for stateful workloads across cloud and bare-metal environments.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Meet one or more of these alternatives: built and operated distributed storage systems with a grasp of first principles; systems engineering experience in one or more of filesystems, block devices, kernel I/O paths, SPDK, io_uring, vhost-user-blk, ublk, or virtualization; understanding of algorithms and techniques for fast, reliable storage systems; experience building large distributed systems where consistency and availability were critical; Linux I/O-layer performance engineering; or systems programming with Rust. These are alternatives, not cumulative requirements.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Background in adjacent infrastructure, such as hypervisor I/O, kernel development, distributed systems, or persistent memory, with interest in applying that experience to storage.

must_haves.requirement: Meet one or more of these alternatives: built and operated distributed storage systems with a grasp of first principles; systems engineering experience in one or more of filesystems, block devices, kernel I/O paths, SPDK, io_uring, vhost-user-blk, ublk, or virtualization; understanding of algorithms and techniques for fast, reliable storage systems; experience building large distributed systems where consistency and availability were critical; Linux I/O-layer performance engineering; or systems programming with Rust. These are alternatives, not cumulative requirements.
must_haves.source_quote:
You should meet one or more of the following requirements:

 - You've built and operated distributed storage systems and have a strong grasp of first-principles.

 - You have strong systems engineering experience in one or more of: filesystems, block devices, kernel I/O paths, SPDK, io_uring, vhost-user-blk, ublk or virtualization

 - You have a deep understanding of the algorithms and techniques behind building fast, performant and reliable storage systems.

 - You have experience building large distributed systems where consistency and availability was critical.

 - You have a strong background in performance engineering at the I/O layer on Linux.

 - You have strong foundation in systems programming with Rust.

preferences.requirement: Background in adjacent infrastructure, such as hypervisor I/O, kernel development, distributed systems, or persistent memory, with interest in applying that experience to storage.
preferences.source_quote: If your background is in adjacent infrastructure (hypervisor I/O, kernel development, distributed systems, persistent memory) and you want to apply that depth to storage, we want to hear from you.

location.requirement_text: No geographic filter: the role explicitly allows global remote work.
source_quotes: We're distributed ALL across the globe, and that's only going to be more and more distributed.

soft_requirements: Comfort owning a problem independently at a small company.
Judgment about the longevity of technical solutions and willingness to implement, scale, and replace them when needed.
Ability to communicate and document solutions effectively.
